title: useActionState: state from an Action's result

slides.say: Use action state gives you state that is updated with the result of an Action.
Pass a reducer action and an initial state. You get back the current state, a dispatch action to call, and is pending.
Give the dispatch action to the form. Whatever your function returns becomes the new state, here the error.

slides.text: It gets the previous state first. Multiple calls run in order.
slides.say: Your function receives the previous state first, then the payload. Multiple calls are queued and run in order, each getting the last result.
